# Project Instructions addition — Bolt AI-SDLC V1

Add this stable rule to the Cloud dev - Bolt v1 Project Instructions:

> For new feature ideas initiated after the Bolt AI-SDLC V1 adoption checkpoint, use the repository's prospective workflow in docs/AI_SDLC.md. Existing work already in progress at adoption remains on its current workflow unless the user explicitly opts it in. When the user invokes @feature-scoper, types /feature-scoper, or explicitly asks to run the Bolt feature SDLC, use the installed feature-scoper skill; if unavailable, load skills/feature-scoper/SKILL.md and follow the same workflow. Do not begin coding until the frozen scope has exact PM, Senior Tech Manager/CTO and Head QA approval, plus any required risk-routed specialist approval. Human decisions are authoritative; pause for genuinely unresolved material human input and never silently override it. AI may plan, implement, test, commit and push authorized feature branches, but must stop at READY FOR HUMAN REVIEW. Humans own merge, release, deployment and live production mutation.

This source-controlled file does not itself change ChatGPT Project settings or install/enable a workspace skill.
